name: mystic-matrix
description: MYSTIC MATRIX - The Enchanted Inventory for Every Potion and Prophecy

scripts.android:sync: cd frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: export JAVA_HOME="$HOME/.local/jdk-17/Contents/Home" && export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" && cd frontend/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.android:build:release: export JAVA_HOME="$HOME/.local/jdk-17/Contents/Home" && export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" && cd frontend/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon
scripts.android:open: cd frontend && npx cap open android

author: Madam Hex Dev Team
